description: This PHP source file defines the 'FunctionalTestingPluginConfiguration' class, which implements plugin and console configuration interfaces for the OrangeHRM system's functional testing plugin. It sets up class autoloading and subscribes to events, and registers command-line commands related to database savepoints when not in production mode.

classes.name: FunctionalTestingPluginConfiguration
classes.description: A configuration class for setting up the functional testing plugin in OrangeHRM, handling autoloading, event subscription, and command registration.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes autoloading for the plugin classes and subscribes to the event dispatcher.

methods.name: registerCommands
methods.description: Registers database-related commands for the console interface, except in production environment.
